universe.description: cross-sectional: computed over the whole universe

other.description: the second indicator for indicator_compare and indicator_cross

are added on top (use that for the benchmark, usually SPY).
EquiblesImport.title: EquiblesImport

sweep_value.description: value of idle cash held in the benchmark (idle_cash setting)
sweep_value.title: Sweep Value

kind.description: 'signal' (exit when any condition passes) or a registered exit rule id
kind.title: Kind

csv.description: sessions in the import format: date,symbol,open,...
csv.title: Csv

start.description: last history session (default: the snapshot's last)
start.title: Start

cooldown_bars.description: bars after an exit fill before the same symbol may enter again. Omitted means no cooldown rule is applied.
cooldown_bars.title: Cooldown Bars

cost_model.description: legacy_unapplied records a cost but does not charge it (the historical engine). research_bps charges cost_bps_per_side. Omitted means the historical engine.
cost_model.title: Cost Model

freeze_entry_levels.description: when true, store the finite indicator values from the entry decision on the buy fill. Exit rules still read live indicators.
freeze_entry_levels.title: Freeze Entry Levels

idle_cash.description: what cash not needed by a position does: stay as cash (default) or be held in whole shares of the benchmark, sold at the open when a trade needs the cash
idle_cash.title: Idle Cash

RankBy.description: Order in which a session's entry candidates claim cash and position slots.

order.description: ascending: lowest value first (e.g. most oversold RSI)
order.title: Order

RankBy.title: RankBy

analysis.description: research analysis; null when it cannot be computed

edge_mean.description: average edge per trade vs the benchmark

edge_mean.description: average edge per trade vs the benchmark
edge_mean.title: Edge Mean

name.description: typed label, then source, timeframe, universe and dates
name.title: Name

entry_signals.description: conditions on the entry row. A buy also needs every one of these to pass, along with `entry`.
entry_signals.title: Entry Signals

exits.description: several exit rules; the first that fires sells the whole position. When given it replaces `exit`.
exits.title: Exits

rank_by.description: order entry candidates by an indicator; default ascending symbol order

timeframe.description: bar size; when omitted, the run takes the snapshot's bar size
timeframe.title: Timeframe

trade_start.description: first session that may trade. Earlier sessions in the loaded bars warm indicators and cannot fill or signal. Omitted means every loaded session may trade.
trade_start.title: Trade Start

Daily bars from Tiingo. A watchlist's current members are included too; ``symbols``

legs.description: The clicked fill, or the buy and the sell when a round trip is opened.
legs.title: Legs
